meta.name: dbt-knowledgebase
meta.description: Populate the knowledge base from dbt project research. Proposes entries across all 6 categories at org, project, and connection scopes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从 dbt 项目研究中提取知识并填充知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在维护 dbt 项目并希望自动记录数据模型知识
copy.tagline_en: Extract knowledge from dbt project research and populate the knowledge base
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a dbt project and want to automatically document data model knowledge

howto.what: 完成 dbt 项目探索（步骤1-5）后，自动提出知识条目，涵盖理解、约定、决策、领域规则、调试、怪癖六个类别，并检查是否已有条目以避免重复。
howto.when: 在完成 dbt 项目的探索步骤（1-5）之后触发，生成或更新知识库。

say.text: 请为这个 dbt 项目填充所有类别的知识条目。
检查并补充 dbt 知识库中缺失的理解和约定条目。
根据探索结果，更新项目级决策和调试信息。

howto.what_en: After completing Steps 1-5 of dbt project exploration, automatically propose knowledge entries across all six categories (understanding, conventions, decisions, domain-rules, debugging, quirks) and check for duplicates.
howto.when_en: Triggers after the exploration phase (Steps 1-5) of a dbt project workflow to populate or update the knowledge base.

say_en.text: Populate all knowledge categories for this dbt project.
Check and add missing understanding and conventions entries.
Update project-scope decisions and debugging based on findings.
